capabilities: Generate an AI writing prompt from the current selection or section
Send note text to ChatGPT to act as an interested reader
Run prompt generation from the command palette or sidebar icon
extras: Requires users to obtain and configure an OpenAI API key in the plugin settings.
problem: When you are stuck and do not know what to write next, Obsidian offers no way to get questions or prompts about your own draft.
summary: AI plugin that generates writing prompts from your selected text to keep you writing when you are stuck.
